dogecoin.text: Shiba Inu Flips Dogecoin on CoinGecko, Defying Elon Musk.  According to CoinGecko data, SHIB's current market cap is $31.8 billion, which is $636 million higher than that of DOGE. However, the flippening is yet to happen on CoinMarketCap. #Cryptos #shibainucoin #SHIB #SHIBARMY

Is Elon Musk's influence over the cryptocurrency market dwindling? SHIB is up 420% this month, crushing other altcoins.
